GitGate + RefPusher) and implements the command-template backend that runs a\n// bash executor on the same box.\n//\n// Phase 1a (bf-23i): configurable argv templates with placeholder substitution.\n// The command backend implements RemoteBackend using user-configured argv arrays:\n// - submit: runs configured submit argv with {repo}, {rev}, {args_json} placeholders\n// - logs: runs configured logs argv with {handle} placeholder for streaming\n// - wait: runs configured wait argv with {handle} placeholder, maps exit code to verdict\n\nuse crate::backend::{BackendError,   /// Submit command argv array. Placeholders: {repo}, {rev}, {args_json}.\n    /// Example: [\"my-ci\", \"submit\", \"--repo\", \"{repo}\", \"--rev\", \"{rev}\", \"--args\", \"{args_json}\"]\n    pub submit: Vec<String>,\n\n    /// Logs command argv array. Placeholder: {handle}.\n    /// Example: [\"my-ci\", \"logs\", \"{handle}\", \"--follow\"]\n    pub logs: Vec<String>,\n\n    /// Wait command argv array. Placeholder: {handle}.\n    /// Example: [\"my-ci\", \"wait\", \"{handle}\"]\n    pub wait: Vec<String>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for CommandConfig {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        // Phase 0.5 compatible defaults: contrib/gantry-exec.sh\n        // Respect GANTRY_EXEC_PATH environment variable if set (for integration tests)\n        let executor_path = std::env::var(\"GANTRY_EXEC_PATH\")\n            .unwrap_or_else(|_| \"./contrib/gantry-exec.sh\".to_string());\n\n        CommandConfig {\n            submit: vec![\n                executor_path.clone(),\n                \"submit\".to_string(),\n                \"{repo}\".to_string(),\n                \"{rev}\".to_string(),\n                \"{args_json}\".to_string(),\n            ],\n            logs: vec![\n                executor_path.clone(),\n                \"logs\".to_string(),\n                \"{handle}\".to_string(),\n            ],\n            wait: vec![executor_path, \"wait\".to_string(), at the argv level (no shell interpolation, S-4).\nfn substitute_placeholders(\n    argv: &[String],\n    repo: &str,\n    rev: &str,\n    args_json: &str,\n    handle: Option<&str>,\n) -> Vec<String> {\n    argv.iter()\n        .map(|arg| {\n            let mut result = arg.clone();\n            if let Some(h) = handle {\n                result = result.replace(\"{handle}\", h);\n            }\n            result\n                .replace(\"{repo}\", repo)\n                .replace(\"{rev}\", rev)\n                .replace(\"{args_json}\", args_json)\n        })\n        .collect()\n}\n\n/// \"submit\".to_string(),\n                \"{repo}\".to_string(),\n                \"{rev}\".to_string(),\n                \"{args_json}\".to_string(),\n            ],\n            logs: vec![\n }\n\n        let cmd = &argv[0];\n        let args = &argv[1..];\n\n        Command::new(cmd)\n            .args(args)\n            .output()\n            .map_err(|e| BackendError::new(&format!(\"failed to run command: {}\", e)))\n    }\n\n    /// Format args as JSON array.\n    ///\n    /// Phase 1a: use serde_json for robust JSON handling (S-4 compliance).\n {args_json} placeholders.\n    /// The command's stdout is the handle (an opaque string that wait() can use).\n    fn submit(&self, spec: &RunSpec) -> Result<RunHandle, BackendError> {\n        let args_json = Self::format_args_json(&spec.args);\n        let argv = substitute_placeholders(\n            &self.config.submit,\n            &spec.repo_url,\n            &spec.sha,\n            &args_json,\n            None,\n        );\n\n        let output = self.run_command(&argv)?;\n\n        if !output.status.success() {\n            return Err(BackendError::new(&format!(\n                \"submit command failed: {}\",\n                String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)\n            )));\n        }\n\n        let handle = }\n245\t\n246\t    /// Discover the pod name for a workflow by listing pods.\n247\t    fn discover_pod(&self, workflow_name: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, BackendError> {\n248\t        let output = kubectl create -f -.\n281\t    /// The workflow name (stdout) becomes the handle.\n282\t    fn submit(&self, spec: &RunSpec) -> Result<crate::backend::RunHandle, BackendError> {\n283\t        // &self.config.template,\n291\t            &spec.repo_url,\n292\t            &spec.sha,\n293\t            &args_json,\n294\t        );\n295\t\n296\t        // Serialize to JSON\n297\t        let .stdout(std::process::Stdio::piped())\n316\t            .stderr(std::process::Stdio::piped())\n317\t            .spawn()\n318\t            .map_err(|e| BackendError::new(&format!(\"failed to spawn ///\n386\t    /// Polls kubectl get workflow status.phase until terminal or deadline.\n387\t    /// Reads verdict.json from outputs.parameters if available.\n388\t    fn wait(\n389\t        &self,\n390\t        h: &crate::backend::RunHandle,\n391\t        deadline: Instant,\n392\t    ) -> Result<Verdict, BackendError> {\n393\t        loop {\n394\t            // Check deadline\n395\t {\n424\t                                                // Fall back to exit code if verdict.json parsing fails\n425\t                                                eprintln!(\n426\t                                                    \"[gantry] failed to parse verdict.json: {}\",\n427\t                                                    e\n428\t                                                );\n429\t                                            }\n430\t                                        }\n431\t                                    }\n432\t                                }\n433\t                            }\n434\t                        }\n435\t                    }\n436\t\n437\t                    // Fall back to phase-based classification\n438\t                    return Ok(match status.phase.as_str() {\n439\t                        \"Succeeded\" => Verdict::Pass,\n440\t                        \"Failed\" => Verdict::TestFailure,\n441\t                        \"Error\" => Verdict::InfraFailure,\n442\t                        _ => Verdict::InfraFailure,\n443\t                    });\n444\t                }\n445\t                _ => {\n446\t                    // Not
